## Description
Provide a detailed description of the changes made, the issue solved, and any user feedback incorporated.

## Related Issues
Closes # (issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have ran backend tests (`./mvnw test`) and verified 100% successes.
- [ ] I have verified compile build health (`npm run build`) for frontend bundle assets.
- [ ] I have added JavaDoc/JSDoc comments where appropriate.
- [ ] I have updated corresponding API documentation (`docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md`) if endpoints changed.
